Valores y forma de trabajar

flags.title: Keyboard focus is invisible
flags.detail: 12 of the first 80 tab stops show no focus indicator (for example: input "unnamed", input "unnamed", input "unnamed", select "Select a practice area (optional)Personal InjuryCar Accident"). A keyboard user cannot see where they are.

flags.title: Hidden controls can be tabbed to
flags.detail: 2 tab stops land on controls inside a hidden region (for example: a "Explore practice areas→" inside div opacity:0; a "Read them all on Google" inside div opacity:0), usually a closed menu, drawer or modal.

flags.title: Keyboard focus gets trapped
flags.detail: Tab keeps landing on input "unnamed" and cannot move past it.

flags.title: Links open new tabs without saying so
flags.detail: 5 links use target="_blank" with no "(opens in new tab)" hint (for example: Read them all on Google, 13201 Northwest Freeway, Suite 485, Hous, Instagram ↗, 13201 Northwest FreewaySuite 485Houston,).

flags.title: Content moves for more than five seconds with no pause control
flags.detail: 2 animation(s) run longer than five seconds (a ticker, marquee or carousel) and the page has no visible pause, stop or play control. Pausing on hover or focus helps but is not a control a visitor can find; WCAG 2.2.2 asks for one.

flags.title: No skip link
flags.detail: The first Tab press should offer a link past the navigation to the main content. A keyboard user must otherwise tab through every menu item on every page.
